description: Search OpenAlex's open scholarly index, pull works by ID / author / journal / institution, or walk citations in either direction. No cookies or login required. An optional free OpenAlex API key only unlocks cursor paging beyond 10,000 results.

apiKey.description: Optional free key from openalex.org/settings/api. Only needed for cursor paging past 10,000 results or a larger daily request budget. Never required.
apiKey.title: OpenAlex API key (optional)

authorIds.description: OpenAlex author IDs (A...) or ORCIDs, for byAuthorIds.
authorIds.title: Author IDs / ORCIDs

citationDirection.description: Which side of the citation graph to walk when mode is getCitationGraph.
enumTitles: Forward: works that cite the seed
citationDirection.title: Citation direction (getCitationGraph)

customFilter.description: Advanced: an extra OpenAlex filter expression, e.g. language:en,is_retracted:false or topics.id:T10102. Combined with the filters above.
customFilter.title: Raw OpenAlex filter

hasFulltextOnly.description: Only works where OpenAlex has machine-readable full text.
hasFulltextOnly.title: Has searchable full text only

includeAbstract.description: Reconstruct readable abstract text from OpenAlex's inverted index. No extra API calls.
includeAbstract.title: Include abstract

includeAuthorships.description: Include every author, their affiliations and corresponding-author flag.
includeAuthorships.title: Include full authorships

includeCitationIds.description: Include referencedWorks / relatedWorks ID arrays and the citedBy API URL. Off by default because long reference lists make records large.
includeCitationIds.title: Include citation ID lists

includeConcepts.description: Include OpenAlex's deprecated concept tags (kept for backward compatibility). Prefer topics.
includeConcepts.title: Include legacy concepts

includeOpenAccessLocations.description: Include all OA landing pages / PDFs, licenses and the OpenAlex full-text PDF and TEI links when available.
includeOpenAccessLocations.title: Include every open-access copy

includeTopics.description: Include the current OpenAlex topic hierarchy, keyword tags and UN Sustainable Development Goals.
includeTopics.title: Include topics, keywords and SDGs

institutionIds.description: OpenAlex institution IDs (I...) or ROR URLs, for byInstitutionIds. Examples: I136199984 (Harvard), I32971472 (MIT), https://ror.org/042nb2s44.
institutionIds.title: Institution IDs / ROR IDs

minCitedBy.description: Drop works cited fewer times than this. 0 means no minimum.
minCitedBy.title: Minimum citations

mode.description: Pick a search mode, a direct-lookup mode, or a citation direction.
enumTitles: Works that cite a paper (forward citations)
Works a paper cites (references / backward citations)
Fetch specific works by ID / DOI / PMID
Every work by an author ID / ORCID
Every work in a venue / journal ID / ISSN
Every work affiliated with an institution ID / ROR
mode.title: What to fetch

oaStatus.description: Filter by OpenAlex's OA colour. Any status other than 'any' also implies open access.
enumTitles: Hybrid (open license in a toll journal)
Bronze (free to read, no open license)
oaStatus.title: Open-access status

openAccessOnly.description: Only return works with a free, legal full-text copy.
openAccessOnly.title: Open access only

perPage.description: How many records to request per page (1-100). Smaller pages keep the daily test cheap.
perPage.title: Results per API page

publicationYearMax.description: Drop works published after this year. Sent to OpenAlex as a server-side filter.
publicationYearMax.title: Publication year to

publicationYearMin.description: Drop works published before this year. Sent to OpenAlex as a server-side filter.
publicationYearMin.title: Publication year from

searchField.description: Which text field the query searches. Title/abstract options are much cheaper and faster than full text.
enumTitles: Everything OpenAlex searches (title, abstract, full text, keywords)
Title, abstract and keywords (OpenAlex website default)
Full text when available, plus title and abstract
searchField.title: Search in

searchQuery.description: Keyword, phrase, or OpenAlex Boolean query. Used by searchWorks and searchAuthors. In searchWorks it may be omitted when at least one filter is set (filter-only browsing).
searchQuery.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Ordering for works. Relevance requires a search query; filter-only modes fall back to most cited.
sortBy.title: Sort by

startCursor.description: Optional saved OpenAlex cursor for a resumable cursor-paged run. Leave empty to start from the beginning.
startCursor.title: Start cursor

startPage.description: Resume page-based paging from this page (1-10000 combined with perPage must stay within 10,000 results).
startPage.title: Start page

useCursor.description: Follow OpenAlex next_cursor pages instead of page numbers. Needs the optional free API key; without it the actor uses page paging.
useCursor.title: Use cursor paging

userAgentEmail.description: Email sent in the User-Agent so OpenAlex can contact you about API usage. The default works; supply your own for high-volume runs.
userAgentEmail.title: Contact email (polite pool)

venueIds.description: OpenAlex source IDs (S..., journal / repository / conference) or ISSNs, for byVenueIds. Examples: S4306400194 (arXiv), S137773608 (Nature), 0028-0836.
venueIds.title: Venue / source IDs / ISSNs

workIds.description: Used by byWorkIds and as the citation seeds for getCitations / getReferences / getCitationGraph. Accepts OpenAlex W-IDs, DOI URLs, bare DOIs, PMIDs, PMCIDs and MAG IDs. Examples: W2741809807, https://doi.org/10.1145/3442188.3445922, pmid:25524000.
workIds.title: Work IDs / DOIs / PMIDs

title: OpenAlex works, citations & open access
